title: Opening apps
drDigitalIntro:
To open an app, click its icon in the dock at the bottom of the screen.
• Each icon represents a different app — click it once to open it.
• A window will appear on the desktop.
• If an app is not in the dock, you can search your computer's files for it.
• Let's practice: open any four apps from the dock.

playgroundTask.instructions: Open any 4 apps from the dock — pick whichever ones you like!

drDigitalSuccess: That's how you open apps — click and go! You opened four of them.
drDigitalHint: Click any icon at the bottom of the desktop to open that app. Try clicking four different icons.
